source_interfaces.public_catalogue: Catalogue(catalogue_json['profiles']); immutable copy with unique paid IDs in [0,4095]
source_interfaces.source_serialize: serialize_groups(actual_source_scales, public_profile); raster order only; TX only
source_interfaces.transmitter: transmit(profile_id, payloads, public_counter, catalog, backend); no true SNR input
source_interfaces.receiver: receive(noisy_samples, true_snr, public_counter, catalog, backend); no transmitter ID, original pixels/tokens, clean waveform or oracle inputs
source_interfaces.audit: audit_after_receiver(event, tx_profile_id, tx_payloads); returns separate truth labels without mutating event

backend.actual_precondition: Owner must bind the actual modules/runtime and verify_catalogue(catalog) against actual backend plan metadata before registered scientific execution.
backend.packet_ledger: Mandatory begin/done/failed callback for each actual header/body TX or RX call; begin occurs before invocation and can reject budget admission; no retry.
backend.modulation: Explicit QPSK=2,16QAM=4,64QAM=6 dispatch through current main_raw64_packet_adapter; historical old else=4 is never used for 64QAM.
backend.noise_generation: Not implemented or run by this module; owner supplies actual noisy samples from the registered namespace/counter/channel.

receive_rule.effective_rule: DROP at first CRC-rejected group; gray RGB=0.5 without valid base, only j complete scales for base-only, actual full selected prefix when both accepted
receive_rule.later_group: G2 is physically decoded even when G1 fails so its real CRC state is retained; it never bypasses the missing base in reconstruction.
receive_rule.legal_wrong_header: Decode according to the received legal public ID. Original G1 formats remain legal but use DROP within the new grouped receiver, regardless of their historical KEEP metadata.
receive_rule.old_single_baselines: Unchanged separate original raw433 receiver/domain; this new mixed-domain receiver is not substituted for their physical outputs.
receive_rule.undetected_errors: CRC-accepted actual wrong values remain in the reconstruction state. Truth comparisons occur only after RX, in a separate audit result.
receive_rule.infrastructure_failure: Malformed backend dimensions or contradictory CRC flags raise and are preserved; not converted into protocol gray failures.

resource_accounting.each_group: 12 bits per token + CRC16; independent actual LDPC packet; q from explicit modulation
resource_accounting.energy: Record actual header/group/idle/frame sum-squared energy and actual frame mean Es. No per-frame normalization or base-group power boost. Idle symbols are original [1,1] with energy 2 each.
